name: mock-verifier
description: WireMock stand-in for an A2A 1.0 verifier agent (local development only). It reviews a pushed commit and answers with a `verdict` artifact.

skills.name: Verify
skills.description: Reviews a commit and answers with a verdict: findings for a commit of forty `a`, a pass for any other.
examples: Check that commit aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa, pushed as described below, does what the task asks.
